integrity: The proof states all parameters and equality cases. Code is standalone and uses no private data. The supporting unweighted polar calculation is not independently claimed as original.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional real Euclidean nearest-point projection, with coordinatewise maximum-norm sensitivity. The exact all-weight stability and optimizer classification are proved analytically; numerical checks are finite. Earlier literature supplies epigraph projector formulas and derivatives; independent novelty review remains outstanding.
title: Sharp coordinatewise stability of weighted epigraph projections and their polar cones
